sections.content_text: Section 265 - Display of Proof of Submission of Return (1) A taxpayer whose income is derived from business liable to file a return under this Act shall display the proof of filing of return in a place where it is easily visible at his place of business. (2) Where a taxpayer fails to comply with the provisions of subsection (1), the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes may impose a fine of not less than 5 (five) thousand and not more than 20 (twenty) thousand.
